faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.intro: Short answers. Call us if yours is not here.
faq.q1: Where should I start if I have never had a routine?
faq.a1: Start with three steps: a gentle cleanser, one moisturiser and a sunscreen in the morning. Add a serum after a few weeks, once your skin is comfortable.
faq.q2: Why do I need sunscreen in winter?
faq.a2: Mongolia is high and the air is thin, so UV is strong. Snow reflects it back onto your face. Wear sunscreen on cloudy days as well.
faq.q3: My skin feels tight indoors. What helps?
faq.a3: Heating dries the air. Wash with lukewarm water, apply essence on damp skin, then a cream. Do not go outside straight after washing.
faq.a4: Put a small amount on the inner arm and leave it for 24 hours. If you see redness or itching, do not use the product on your face.
faq.q5: Can I use retinoids while pregnant or breastfeeding?
faq.a5: Ask your doctor first. Our eye serum contains retinal, which is a retinoid, so check with your doctor before using it.
faq.q6: How often should I use the acid toner?
faq.a6: Start with 2 to 3 evenings a week. If your skin feels fine, you can use it more. Always wear sunscreen the next day.
faq.a7: Ulaanbaatar takes {ubMin} to {ubMax} days. Countryside cargo takes {csMin} to {csMax} days to the terminal. Pickup is ready within {puMax} days.
faq.a8: Delivery to a Ulaanbaatar address is free for orders from {amount}. Below that it costs {fee}. Pickup is always free.
faq.a9: Pay on delivery or by bank transfer. We never ask for card details on this site.
faq.a10: Yes, unopened items within 7 days. Opened skincare cannot be returned for hygiene reasons.
faq.q11: Are the products and photos real?
faq.a11: This is a demo shop. Product names, descriptions and photographs come from the brand pages listed on the credits page. Prices, stock and delivery terms are made up, and no real order is taken.
